trap: A brick trough across the floor holds a film of acid only two cells deep; walking through it costs about 60 HP, a potion on an islet in the middle lures the careless
cue: The trough is lined with brick instead of ground; inspect reports acid; the islet is a stepping stone with two jumps of 14 cells each
notes: Acid is allowed here because the brick trough holds it (brick is not corrodible). Solutions: two jumps over the islet, levitate over, or pour water on the film (acid eats the water and dissolves). Gate (routes.py): crossing, the air above the trough and the trough. The left wall of the trough runs down to the floor of the scene, so the rock under it cannot be tunnelled.

lessons.note: Acid meets water-family liquids (water, blood), eats them away and turns them into flammable gas: this is how the thin acid layer gets cleared
